units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite> <he>חזר וכְלָלָן כולן וכ׳</he> (not <he>וכללו כולו</he>) he again included them all in the praise (<cite ref="Genesis 1:31">Gen. I, 31</cite>).
<cite ref="Shevuot 23b:8">Shebu. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>בכוֹלֵל המותרים וכ׳</he> when he (in his vow) includes permitted things as well as forbidden things.
<cite ref="Shevuot 24a:2">Ib. 24ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>איסור כולל</he>, v. <cite ref="A01405"><he>אִיסּוּר</he></cite>.
R. Hash. IV, 5 וכולל מלכיות עמהן and inserts that section of prayers concerning the divine rulership, v. מַלְכוּת; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּלוּל, f. כְּלוּלָה

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:7:2">Y. Pes. V, 32ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ירידת גשמים כ׳ וכ׳</he> the praise for the rain-fall is included therein (<cite ref="Psalms 135:7">Ps. CXXXV, 7</cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:9:8">Y. Taan. III, 67ᵃ</cite>, end.—

senses.gloss: to be implied, to be stated in general terms, opp. נפרט. Y. Sot. VII, 21ᵈ top דברים שנִכְלָלוּ ונפרטו things which have been stated both implicitly and specifically.
to crown. Tanḥ. R’eh 7 אם נוצחין … ומְכַלְּלִין אותו when they (the legions) are victorious, they come and make a wreath, and crown him (the king).
to include, imply. Part. pass. מְכוּלָּל, pl. מְכוּלָּלִים enclosed (as a germ), potential.
